simple.meaning: זָקַף (zâqaph) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to life , i.e. (figuratively) comfort.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in Psalms, beginning at Psalms 145:14. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זָקַף (H2210) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: זָקַף (zâqaph) / H2210 is traced through Psalms 145:14, Psalms 146:8 with source-language evidence and verse context.
